name: Macropad
description: Bind OpenClaw sessions to the keys of a USB macropad, with live status lighting. Includes a driver for the Work Louder Codex Micro.

enabled.label: Enabled
enabled.help: Master switch. When off, the plugin releases the device and stops all lighting.

deviceSerial.label: Device Serial
deviceSerial.help: Pin to one macropad by serial number. Leave empty to use the first supported device found.

autoBind.label: Auto-bind Sessions
autoBind.help: Automatically assign active sessions to free keys, evicting the least recently used session when every key is taken. Pinned keys are never evicted.

useSessionColors.label: Match Sidebar Colours
useSessionColors.help: Use each session's own sidebar colour as its key colour, so the device and the Control UI agree on what colour a session is. When off, all keys use the status colours below.

brightness.label: Brightness
brightness.help: Key brightness for active sessions, from 0 to 1.

idleBrightness.label: Idle Brightness
idleBrightness.help: Dimmed brightness for bound sessions that are not currently doing anything.

colorThinking.label: Working Colour
colorThinking.help: Key colour while a session is running. Used only when Match Sidebar Colours is off.

colorAwaitingApproval.label: Awaiting Approval Colour
colorAwaitingApproval.help: Key colour while a session is blocked on an approval.

colorError.label: Error Colour
colorError.help: Key colour after a session fails.

resyncIntervalSeconds.label: Resync Interval (s)
resyncIntervalSeconds.help: Device lighting is volatile and drifts if left alone, so the full key frame is repainted on this interval. Raise it to reduce USB traffic.
